name: SEIS automation registry
purpose: Register every persistent-record automation with the state-model entity it writes, its sync rule, and its disable path, so the automation_expansion gate stays auditable and reversible.

global_kill_switch.effect: When truthy, registered automations must exit before writing; only --check (read-only verification) is allowed.
global_kill_switch.ultimate_disable: Remove the npm script or CI step, or revert the automation's commit; state-model records are restored from their seed_sources.

coverage_rule: Any new write-capable automation (scheduled job, bot, or external/server-side write) must be added here, mapped to a state-model entity with a sync rule, and given a disable path before the automation_expansion gate permits it to run.

automations.sync_rule: Regenerate from the data/*.json sources; never hand-edit the generated bundle.
automations.disable_path: Honor SEIS_AUTOMATION_DISABLED, or remove the automation:cockpit-status script; the bundle is reproducible from sources.

writes: data records derived from the Codex plugin export
automations.sync_rule: Regenerate from the Codex plugin list export; never hand-edit records.
automations.disable_path: Honor SEIS_AUTOMATION_DISABLED, or remove the automation:plugin-environment-sources script.

automations.sync_rule: Derived from plugin_registry aggregation once live; static counts until then.
automations.disable_path: Honor SEIS_AUTOMATION_DISABLED, or remove the automation:plugin-capability-lanes script.
